channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Three-year-old girl dies after being found unconscious in pond
item.description: IPOH: A three-year-old girl died after she was found unconscious in a drainage pond near her home in Simpang 4 Permatang Pelandok, Teluk Intan, yesterday.

item.title: Police detain three men over armed rioting in Kuala Langat
item.description: SHAH ALAM: Police have detained three men suspected of rioting with weapons in Jalan Waja, Telok Panglima Garang, Kuala Langat, near here yesterday.

item.title: Aaron-Wooi Yik face dangerous Taiwan pair in BAC opener
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Aaron Chia-Soh Wooi Yik will have to tread cautiously in their bid to defend their men’s doubles crown at the Badminton Asia Championships (BAC) in Ningbo, China from April 7-12.

item.title: 'Has mum been buried?' asks girl after mother dies in crash
item.description: SETIU: “Has mum been buried?” That was the question asked by Nur Raesha Amanda Mohd Redzuan, 14, after she was informed by family members that her mother, Nurul Hafizah Shaary, 39, had died in an accident yesterday.

item.title: Muslims urged to perform prayers for rain amid hot weather
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: Muslims are urged to perform Solat Sunat Istisqa’ (prayers for rain) following the ongoing hot and dry weather sweeping across the country.

item.title: Malaysia Education Blueprint 2026–2036 aims to reduce teachers' workload
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Education Ministry (MOE) remains committed to implementing initiatives to ease teachers’ workload, as outlined in the Malaysia Education Blueprint (RPM) 2026–2035.

item.title: No last minute opening for Zii Jia and Aidil Sholeh at BAC
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: There will be no last-minute inclusion for either Aidil Sholeh Ali Sadikin or Lee Zii Jia in the men’s singles event at the Badminton Asia Championships (BAC), despite earlier hopes.

item.title: Azam urges MACC staff to remain steadfast amid criticism
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) chief commissioner Tan Sri Azam Baki has reminded commission staff to always be prepared to face criticism, negative perceptions, and false accusations while performing their duties.

item.title: Dr Dzul honours organ donor Muhammad Zahran in heartfelt tribute
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Health Minister Datuk Seri Dr Dzulkefly Ahmad paid tribute to late Muhammad Zahran Mohd Zuraidi, who donated his organs to save lives after passing away at Hospital Selayang this morning.

item.title: Today's news in pictures – Tuesday, March 24, 2026
item.description: MISSED what happened today? Here's a glimpse at what happened throughout the country in photographs.

item.title: Eight-year-old boy drowns in river on first visit
item.description: SIK: An eight-year-old boy drowned in Sungai Muda at Kampung Tanjung Jeneri near Sik today.

item.title: LLM reports heavy traffic on city-bound routes
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Traffic on several major highways in the country began to build tonight as people returned to the capital after the Aidilfitri holidays.

item.title: Firefighters, police search for elderly man, grandson missing in Keningau river
item.description: KENINGAU: An elderly man and his seven-year-old grandson were reported missing in a river near Taman Bersatu here today.

item.title: Petrol dealers urge govt cooperation to ease RON95 liability
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Petroleum Dealers Association of Malaysia (PDAM) has called for stronger strategic cooperation between the government and petrol station operators to reduce liability burdens on station owners.
